data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Surrender Early Gains as Midterm Polls Close—Analyst Sees ‘Sell the Rumor, Buy the News’ Play
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies retreated late Tuesday evening as investors awaited the outcome of the midterm elections.Crypto Market on Election DayBitcoin climbed to an intraday high of $77,965.50 before pulling back later in the evening.
